top_jobs.job: When I hand a brief to an agent, a freelancer or an agency, help me give them the facts, voice, customer words and proven standards I would give, so I stop rewriting drafts that should have been right the first time

top_jobs.job: When a draft or a live ad carries a claim, help me see whether we can prove it and have permission to use it, so I do not get ads rejected, a refund wave or a legal letter

jobs.job: Crawl the store, pull 12 months of ads, reviews and tickets, and file every fact onto the 22 brain shelves with a source, a date and a tier

inputs.need: every page, product, price and policy on the live site
12 months of ads with copy, media and spend
all reviews with rating, text and product
12 months of tickets with tags
the 22 shelves and what goes on each

steps: Crawl every page and product and save the text, a screenshot and the date
Pull ads, reviews and tickets into one pile with their source ids
Split each item into single facts (a price, a claim, a doubt, an angle) and file each on its shelf
Tag every fact with source, date and tier: site, data, public, inferred
List facts where two sources disagree, like a price on the site and a different one in a live ad
List empty shelves and the interview question that fills each
jobs.output: 22 shelves with an index each, plus a list of conflicts and a list of empty shelves
jobs.next: feeds 05-02 (links), 05-03 (interview skips what is already known) and 05-04 (sign-off)

watch.metric: shelves with at least 1 sourced fact, share of 22

new_enablers.name: Claims register
new_enablers.what: Every claim the brand makes, in three tiers: approved with proof, allowed only as worded, banned. Each claim links to its proof file, its permission, and every ad, email and page that uses it. Scans new drafts and live work for claims and flags any with no match.
inputs: the forbidden list from the founder interview
rights records for reviews, UGC and press
powers: a pass or block on every draft before launch
one sweep when a platform rejects a claim
proof in an hour when a platform, retailer or lawyer asks

new_enablers.name: Site fact watch
new_enablers.what: Crawls the live site every morning and compares price, offers, shipping, returns, guarantee and product specs with the signed record. Names each difference, then finds every live ad, email and page that still carries the old version.
inputs: live ads, email flows and landing pages with their text
powers: same-day notice when a promise changes
no ended offer still running in an ad or flow

new_enablers.name: Review and decision log
new_enablers.what: Logs every draft the founder reviews with approve or reject and the reason, and every founder decision with the date, why and who. A reason that repeats becomes a written rule with the draft that caused it. New proposals are matched against past decisions.
inputs: a simple form or sheet the founder and team fill
powers: a stop on ideas already turned down
first-pass approval rate by writer and agent
